verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit is a code-review SaaS, so an official MCP server that other agents connect to is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The pack only shows CodeRabbit acting as an MCP client: it consumes external MCP servers as a knowledge source, and the pricing page lists "MCP connections". Its agent integrations, such as Claude Code triggering reviews, run through the CLI, and there is no evidence of a first-party MCP server or endpoint exposing CodeRabbit to agents.
